The '''Nyriaan system''' was a [[star system]] in the [[Trans-Vulta sector]] of the [[Mid Rim Territories]]<ref name="Appendix" /> and [[New Territories]].<ref name="NewTerritories" /> It was located in grid square N-7 of the [[Standard Galactic Grid]]<ref name="Appendix" /> and contained the [[planet]] [[Nyriaan]].<ref name="Ezra" /> In [[14 BBY]],<ref name="Dates">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the events of ''[[Ezra's Gamble]]'' to [[5 BBY]]. [[Jenkes]] is stated to have run the [[Nyriaan gladiator arena|arena]] on [[Nyriaan]] nine [[Standard year|years]] prior to the story's events, which equates to [[14 BBY]].</ref> the [[human]] [[Jenkes]] operated a [[Nyriaan gladiator arena|gladiator arena]] on Nyriaan. After leaving Nyriaan and becoming an [[Imperial officer]], Jenkes had the [[Houk]] [[gladiator]] [[Borbig Drob]] and the [[Feeorin]] gladiator [[Warjak]] transported from Nyriaan to the planet [[Lothal]] in a [[shuttle]]<ref name="Ezra" /> in [[5 BBY]].<ref name="Dates" />

==Behind the scenes==
In the current ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]], the Nyriaan system was mentioned in "[[Star Systems of the Galaxy]]," an appendix published with the [[Star Wars Galaxy Map|''Star Wars'' Galaxy Map]] on [[StarWars.com]]<ref name="Appendix" /> on [[June 24]], 2025. Both were written by [[Jason Fry]].<ref name="Substack">{{Substack|subdomain=jasonfry|url=p/about-that-new-star-wars-galaxy-map|text=About That New Star Wars Galaxy Map…|name=[[Jason Fry]]|username=jasonfry|date=2025-06-24}}</ref> In the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity, Nyriaan's [[Star system/Legends|star system]] was named the [[Luire system]] and was first mentioned in ''[[Galaxy of Intrigue]]'', a [[2010]] ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]'' supplement published by [[Wizards of the Coast]].<ref name="GoI">''[[Galaxy of Intrigue]]''</ref> The alternate name Nyriaan system was then introduced an update to the StarWars.com [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' by [[Daniel Wallace]] and Fry.<ref name="Essential Atlas Online Companion">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref>
